## 简体中文

- 修复启用 CN 路由分流后，健康的 FakeIP DNS 前端仍被旧的 real-IP 限制拒绝，导致代理核心启动失败并反复重试的问题。
- CN 路由激活继续要求 DNS 前端已启用、正在运行且核心 DNS 探测成功；FakeIP 与 real-IP 均按运行计划验证，失败时保留具体原因并阻止激活 CN 路由。
- 增加启动门禁的组合回归，并扩展已有 UDP DNS 激活测试覆盖两种应答模式。

## English

- Fix CN routing rejecting a healthy FakeIP DNS frontend because of an obsolete real-IP-only startup check, causing repeated core startup failures.
- Continue requiring an enabled, running frontend and successful core DNS probes before activating CN routes. Validate FakeIP and real-IP answers according to the runtime plan, retain failure details, and keep CN routes disabled on readiness failures.
- Add regression coverage for the startup gate and extend existing UDP DNS activation coverage to both response modes.
